body.name: Two-pass bounded triangular-affine source checker
body.construction: \(\mathsf{CHECK}_{2\mathrm{BTAS}}(S)=1\) exactly when \(S\) is a finite-state program, independent of \(L\), with at most sixteen signed-integer registers; it makes two left-to-right scans of the \(L-1\) nonbaseline levels; every register initializer is affine in \(L\); in one cell, register \(r_k\) is updated to an affine combination of the cell label, \(L\), constants of absolute value at most seven, and pre-update registers \(r_1,\ldots,r_k\); acceptance and branching depend only on the finite label state and boundary position; row emission is affine in the final registers; and no branch queries a register value, slack, rank, validity, facetness, or an external table.
